messages.subject: 2026 Immcantation Users Group Meeting - YouTube
messages.body_plain:
Presentations from the 2026 Immcantation Users Group Meeting <https://immcantation.github.io/users-meeting/2026/program.html> are now available on the Immcantation YouTube channel! <https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL_vz5s41hsdDIRqwwXrF1PyX1AJeblgUz&si=UQO0vHqEvsfORyUK> Thank you to our speakers and participants.

Announcements and reminders:

📅 Save the Date! June 8–11, 2026. AIRR‑C Meeting VIII: Decoding and Recoding Immunity at Yale University. To learn more: https://www.antibodysociety.org/the-airr-community/meetings/airr-community-meeting-viii-decoding-and-recoding-immunity
